title: What is the average lap time for Lewis Hamilton in the 2009 Malaysian Grand
question: What is the average lap time for Lewis Hamilton in the 2009 Malaysian Grand Prix?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT AVG(T1.milliseconds)
FROM raceLapTimes AS T1
INNER JOIN drivers AS T2
  ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
WHERE T2.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND T2.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND T1.year = 2009
  AND T1.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'
